name: GameJam 2020
author: Nwei-glu
description:
A player vs zombie made by Robert Kuszmar and Neien Wei.

Controls:

WASD or arrow key - move character
space - jump
1 - shoot mode
2 - deploy turret mode
3 - heal mode
left click - trigger mode
e - upgrade a turret for $10 while standing next to a turret

For shooting, hold left click to shoot farther

Turrets and health pack cost $5
